name: Petržalský podchod
camera_position: asphalt path at the south (estate) portal of the underpass under Rusovska cesta at Zaporozska (OSM footway way 25736276, axis 350/170 deg)
evidence: reconstruction from one type-reference photo (no photo of the real place); the heading follows the OSM tunnel axis and the game's route (through the tunnel to the Danube side, S30 NNE)
OSM: Rusovska cesta runs 325/145 deg above the tunnel; the Zaporozska bus stops are on it (48.12536,17.09661 / 48.12634,17.09607)
the painted stairs on the right climb the embankment to the road level; Rovniakova (S29) lies SE along Rusovska cesta

S28.to_S30.route: through the tunnel north, then along the embankment to the old bridge

S28.to_S29.route: up the stairs on the right, SE along Rusovska cesta

S28.to_S21.route: path out to the Zaporozska bus stop, bus NW along Rusovska and over the bridge
